title: “IT'S NOT GOING TO HAPPEN!” Arman Tsarukyan SHUTS DOWN Topuria As Ilia Returns To Training!
description:
Ilia Topuria is back in training after his first professional loss, and the UFC lightweight division is already moving around him. Justin Gaethje is champion, Arman Tsarukyan says he is next, and Paddy Pimblett continues to call for the Topuria fight.

This episode looks at the comeback options: an immediate Gaethje rematch, a Paddy Pimblett grudge fight, or a more gradual return while Gaethje and Arman sort out the title picture.

Credits: The Ariel Helwani Show, DOUBLE COVERAGE PODCAST, Submission Radio, Chael Sonnen.
pinned_comment: Who should Ilia Topuria fight next: Paddy Pimblett, a gradual comeback opponent, or Justin Gaethje in the rematch?

Even the man who beat him says Topuria is still one of the best in the world.
